title: Damas 1787: the governor of the Windward Islands to the minister of the Navy, cipher part read (Bouillé cipher of 1778)

plaintext.source: IREL record: "Nouvelles des îles anglaises (chiffrée)"; no gloss.

system.summary: Bouillé cipher of 1778 ("chiffre du 25 avril 1778"): numerical syllabary/nomenclator of about 850 numbers, homophones, code names for islands

prior_solution.where: IREL record gives no plaintext; not in the catalogue or targets/ (checked 28 Oct 2026).

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout chose the target from the catalogue and set the rules (frozen key before validation, held-out checks, prior-work search the day of publication); AI agents transcribed, solved, checked and wrote up. Doubtful signs were settled by targeted visual review where stated.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Cipher identified as Bouillé 1778 (margin note; 92% coverage; same formulas); key K6 of bouille1778 applied.
Frozen K6 on held-out letter no. 415 (C8 A 79 fol. 70) vs modern translation: 0.894 / 0.897 vs max 0.182 / 0.174.

outcome.method_basis: Same cipher as bouille1778; key rebuilt there from pencil glosses and validated on held-out letters.
outcome.fraction_read_source: 298/302 words read in their sense (281 certain, 5 probable, 12 restored, 4 unresolved).

credits.note: cipher identified, letter deciphered with the bouille1778 key, English translation

texts.label: Damas to the minister of the Navy, Martinique, 2 Nov 1787 (cipher part)
texts.summary: If war with England came, Dominica should be seized; Damas lacks siege and field artillery, orders and funds; garrisons of the Windward Islands.
